about_title: Deburring and finishing, made in Italy
about_text: Gecam designs and builds machines for deburring, grinding and finishing metal at Vicofertile, Parma — 100 % made in Italy, with components from Italian suppliers within 125 miles of the plant. Its wide-belt machines deburr, round and satin-finish laser-, punch- and plasma-cut parts from 5-7/8″ to 53-1/8″ wide, dry or wet; its corner grinders and corner welders build and finish metal boxes; and since 2005 its Eurofintec division has built the orbital, centreless and brushing machines that finish tube and pipe.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports Gecam and Eurofintec machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — groups and abrasives chosen for your parts, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
